appraisal_events.evidence: Il est possible que celui-ci eût été provoqué artificiellement par ma mère qui... avait peut-être fait demander à Gilberte de m'écrire, comme... elle remettait en cachette à mon guide baigneur de merveilleuses boîtes en coquillages et des branches de corail que je croyais trouver moi-même au fond des eaux.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator speculates that his mother secretly engineered Gilberte's letter to restore his happiness, comparing it to an earlier act of hidden maternal tenderness, casting her as quietly devoted though the attribution remains hypothetical.

status_effects.explanation: Her hypothesized secret orchestration of the narrator's happiness, echoed against an earlier tender deception, locally casts her as a caring, self-effacing figure, though the narrator frames this only as a possibility.

ambiguities: The mother's role as engineer of Gilberte's letter is explicitly speculative ('Il est possible que', 'avait peut-être fait demander'), so her admiration is attributed conditionally rather than as a stated fact of the scene.
